program: PROJECT ATLAS - Enterprise Capability Verification Program
source_inputs: Google Docs Executive Book 1 Capability Matrix
Google Docs Executive Book 2 Capability Inventory
Google Docs Executive Book 3 Capability Assessment
Google Docs Enterprise Capability Audit baseline

capabilities.name: Search & Discovery
capabilities.description: Public property search, filters, maps, and listing discovery.
capabilities.customer_value: Lets buyers find relevant inventory quickly.
gaps: Production load and recurring smoke evidence must remain current before live traffic expansion.
Search is operationally coupled to Typesense health and queue readiness.

capabilities.name: Property Experience
capabilities.description: Listing detail, media resilience, property inquiry, related inventory, and property schema.
capabilities.customer_value: Turns listing interest into inspectable property context and inquiries.
gaps: Needs continued runtime smoke and inquiry path monitoring in launch posture.

capabilities.name: Buyer Experience
capabilities.description: Buyer journey surfaces, saved searches, preferences, and search-to-inquiry flow.
capabilities.customer_value: Supports buyer intent capture and repeat discovery.
gaps: 197 pending saved-search alert rows still require operator dry-run review before live processing.

capabilities.name: Seller Experience
capabilities.description: Valuation, seller lead capture, seller outreach, and home-value surfaces.
capabilities.customer_value: Captures seller intent and supports pricing/valuation engagement.
gaps: Seller workflow production monitoring and conversion evidence are not established in this wave.

capabilities.name: Market Content
capabilities.description: Market pages, articles, neighborhoods, city hubs, internal links, and content generation.
capabilities.customer_value: Builds market authority and supports SEO-driven discovery.
gaps: Large programmatic publication remains gated by launch readiness, search-index health, and queue diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Customer Accounts
capabilities.description: User, preference, saved-search, unsubscribe, and account-adjacent records.
capabilities.customer_value: Maintains customer state for alerts, preferences, and communication control.
gaps: No complete authenticated customer portal was verified in Wave 1.

capabilities.name: Notifications
capabilities.description: Saved-search alerts, digest/property-inquiry email paths, unsubscribe, tracking, and readiness gates.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps customers engaged with timely property intelligence.
gaps: 197 pending saved-search alert rows require review.
One controlled internal tracked-email click is still required before recurring email/scheduler activation.

capabilities.name: Public Website
capabilities.description: Public home, search, property, market, article, and schema surfaces.
capabilities.customer_value: Provides the launch-facing REIE public experience.
gaps: Wave 1 did not rerun browser/runtime smoke; it records static coverage only.

capabilities.name: Platform Infrastructure
capabilities.description: Next.js, Prisma, Supabase, Redis/BullMQ, Typesense, Docker, and deployment scripts.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps the platform available and operable.
gaps: Disaster recovery and full production resilience evidence were not verified in Wave 1.

capabilities.name: Data Platform
capabilities.description: Prisma schema, migrations, Supabase readiness checks, search indexes, and data preflight.
capabilities.customer_value: Provides durable data and query foundations for REIE.
gaps: Wave 1 did not execute live database checks.

capabilities.name: MLS Operations
capabilities.description: MLS Grid ingestion, page workers, sync state, listing normalization, media processing, and status APIs.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps inventory fresh and searchable.
gaps: 100% stale inventory watch state and long-term sync reliability require continued operational monitoring.

capabilities.name: Security
capabilities.description: Admin API guardrails, unsubscribe safety, environment gates, and protected operational endpoints.
capabilities.customer_value: Protects operational controls and customer communication preferences.
gaps: Wave 1 did not perform penetration, auth, or secret-management testing.

capabilities.name: Reliability
capabilities.description: Readiness scripts, queue dashboard, dead-letter inspection, smoke checks, and launch gating.
capabilities.customer_value: Makes launch state observable and recoverable.
gaps: Monitoring/alerting coverage must be hardened before live recurring operations.

capabilities.name: DevOps
capabilities.description: Build/typecheck/smoke scripts and deployment-oriented command surface.
capabilities.customer_value: Supports repeatable validation and controlled release work.
gaps: CI/CD pipeline execution was not verified in this wave.

capabilities.name: CRM
capabilities.description: CRM tasks, intake signals, strategy intake, lead interactions, and admin review flow.
capabilities.customer_value: Turns user behavior and inquiries into follow-up work.
gaps: One pending medium-priority strategy_intake task remains in watch state.

capabilities.name: Marketing
capabilities.description: Market content, articles, lead capture, email templates, and content scheduling.
capabilities.customer_value: Supports acquisition through content and email engagement.
gaps: Campaign measurement and production marketing operations were not verified.

capabilities.name: Sales
capabilities.description: Lead capture, property inquiry, seller lead, valuation, and CRM follow-up surface.
capabilities.customer_value: Converts buyer/seller intent into action.
gaps: Closed-loop sales reporting was not verified.

capabilities.name: Partnerships
capabilities.description: Partner ecosystem and partner workflow capability.
capabilities.customer_value: Future channel and service expansion.
gaps: No concrete local implementation evidence was identified in Wave 1.

capabilities.name: Customer Success
capabilities.description: Customer lifecycle management after lead creation.
capabilities.customer_value: Improves retention, service follow-through, and post-inquiry experience.
gaps: No dedicated customer-success implementation was verified.

capabilities.name: Executive Intelligence
capabilities.description: Executive visibility into launch state, readiness, queues, and governance.
capabilities.customer_value: Gives leadership a current operating view.
gaps: Dedicated executive dashboard/KPI engine remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Customer Intelligence
capabilities.description: Customer behavior, preference, alert, and lead-performance analytics.
capabilities.customer_value: Improves targeting and follow-up quality.
gaps: Learning loops and customer intelligence dashboards were not fully validated.

capabilities.name: Market Intelligence
capabilities.description: Market analytics, forecasts, pulse, trends, financial engine, and shadow inventory.
capabilities.customer_value: Supports differentiated market insight.
gaps: Production KPI validation and TitlePro247-style provider decisions are not completed.

capabilities.name: Business Intelligence
capabilities.description: Business reporting, KPIs, and operational analytics.
capabilities.customer_value: Supports management decisions and launch monitoring.
gaps: Dedicated KPI engine remains a launch-critical gap.

capabilities.name: AI Decision Support
capabilities.description: AI-assisted recommendations and decision support.
capabilities.customer_value: Future decision acceleration.
gaps: AI productization is explicitly deferred until after REIE launch.

capabilities.name: Enterprise Repository
capabilities.description: Repository v1 schema, objects, relationships, studio, coverage, and recommendations.
capabilities.customer_value: Creates governed enterprise traceability and operating memory.
gaps: Repository is maintenance-only until REIE ships.

capabilities.name: Canon Governance
capabilities.description: Canon relationship to repository governance and execution library boundaries.
capabilities.customer_value: Prevents architecture/identity drift.
gaps: No Canon expansion was performed in Wave 1.

capabilities.name: Traceability
capabilities.description: Repository platform traceability, capability lineage, relationships, and evidence records.
capabilities.customer_value: Lets leadership trace platform assets to enterprise capabilities.
gaps: Future waves can deepen code-level capability lineage.

capabilities.name: Enterprise Governance
capabilities.description: Enterprise governance controls, stewardship, review cycles, and exception handling.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps enterprise decisions measurable and reviewable.
gaps: Broader enterprise governance beyond Repository Closure Cycle 1 was not executed.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Management
capabilities.description: Documentation, handoffs, launch checklist, executive library, and operational records.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps launch work restartable and auditable.
gaps: Executive Library was created locally in this wave and should be maintained as capability truth evolves.

capabilities.name: AI Brand Brain
capabilities.description: Brand-aware AI system.
capabilities.customer_value: Future brand-consistent automation.
gaps: Explicitly deferred until post-launch phase.

capabilities.name: AI Customer Intelligence
capabilities.description: AI-enhanced customer intelligence.
capabilities.customer_value: Future customer learning and personalization.
gaps: AI execution intentionally deferred; no OpenAI calls were made.

capabilities.name: AI Market Intelligence
capabilities.description: AI-enhanced market intelligence.
capabilities.customer_value: Future market interpretation and recommendations.
gaps: AI execution intentionally deferred.

capabilities.name: AI Platform Intelligence
capabilities.description: AI-assisted platform intelligence.
capabilities.customer_value: Future platform operations insight.
gaps: AI execution intentionally deferred.

capabilities.name: Executive Portfolio
capabilities.description: Portfolio-level executive management view.
capabilities.customer_value: Improves leadership prioritization.
gaps: Dedicated portfolio product surface was not verified.

capabilities.name: Capability Management
capabilities.description: Capability matrix, inventory, assessment, register, and gap reporting.
capabilities.customer_value: Creates an executive operating model for capability readiness.
gaps: This is a Wave 1 baseline; later waves should add recurring updates.

capabilities.name: Strategic Planning
capabilities.description: Strategic planning records and decision sequencing.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps launch and post-launch phases ordered.
gaps: No dedicated strategic planning application workflow was verified.

capabilities.name: Enterprise Risk
capabilities.description: Enterprise risk register and launch risk tracking.
capabilities.customer_value: Makes launch risk explicit and actionable.
gaps: Dedicated enterprise risk workflow was not verified.

capabilities.name: Executive Operations
capabilities.description: Executive operating cadence, handoffs, readiness reporting, and decision records.
capabilities.customer_value: Keeps leadership execution disciplined.
gaps: Recurring executive ops cadence must be established after launch.
